title: Fixing MCP credentials in ~/.claude.json has no effect until a restart, and edits can be lost
symptoms: The MCP keeps using the old credentials after the file is fixed
An edit to ~/.claude.json is gone after Claude Code exits
cause: MCP servers read their env when they start, so a running session keeps the old values. Editing ~/.claude.json while Claude Code is running can be overwritten when it exits.
fix: Edit the file with Claude Code closed, or restart afterwards and confirm the change survived.
apply: Quit Claude Code, edit ~/.claude.json, start a new session, then check the value again.
